description: This file provides utilities for configuring LiveKit rooms and tokens, including functions for generating tokens for participants and agents, and for setting up configuration via command-line arguments or environment variables. It is part of a framework to facilitate interaction with LiveKit in a larger application.

methods.name: str generate_token(room_name: str, participant_name: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for a participant in a specified LiveKit room.

methods.name: str generate_token_with_agent( room_name: str, participant_name: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str )
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for an agent participant, with an agent grant.

methods.name: configure()
methods.description: Asynchronously configures and returns the LiveKit server URL, token, and room name, using environment variables or command-line arguments.

methods.name: configure_with_args(parser: Optional[argparse.ArgumentParser] = None)
methods.description: Asynchronously configures and returns the URL, token, and room name, parsing command-line arguments or environment variables.
